# Project Ouroboros: content and style rules

## Content

- The visitor is always called the Wayfarer.
- Keep claims plain, first-person, warm, formal, honest, and lightly wry.
- Never invent metrics, testimonials, clients, results, launches, or expertise.
- Label every unlaunched idea as Concept or Exploring and every simulated demo as Simulated demonstration.
- Do not show numeric statistics. Use words for scale, ranks, sequence, and emphasis.
- Portfolio facts belong in `src/data/content.ts`; UI components read from that source.
- Personal experience is part of the story, never the whole identity.

## Visual world

- Build a quiet grey-fog realm with pewter, ink, violet, oxidised bronze, and one living cyan signal.
- The visitor must enter a fully 3D walk-through: a visible cloaked Fool moves through an endless grey fog above a long bronze council table.
- Use procedural geometry, grain, layered mist, soft light, floating stars, gothic high-backed chairs, and restrained motion over stock imagery.
- The current world is “The Grey Fog Above”; do not reintroduce a town, district ring, or orbiting showcase camera.
- The interface should feel like an instrument inside the world, not a dashboard placed over it.
- Classic View must remain fully equivalent and keyboard-operable.
- Respect `prefers-reduced-motion`, visible focus, readable contrast, and graceful no-microphone/no-audio operation.
